relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: High mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) released by innate immune cells in response to TNF or IL-1β is able to activate both TLR2 and TLR4

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Another key outcome of TLR4 signaling via NF-κB is the activation of the NOD-leucine rich repeat family pyrin domain containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome.

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 signaling stimulates the polarization of macrophages to an inflammatory M1 phenotype

key_findings: Review: TLR4 mediates pancreatic acinar, endothelial and immune cell inflammation in acute pancreatitis
HMGB1 and TLR4/NLRP3 axis are promising therapeutic targets
